jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer to support the configuration, development, integration, testing, deployment, validation, and ongoing maintenance of the IBM Maximo application in a GxP-regulated environment . The associate will work across key Maximo modules, including Work Order, Asset, Location, Purchasing, and Maximo Integration Framework (MIF) . The role requires knowledge of Maximo configuration and development capabilities such as Application Designer, Database Configuration, Automation Scripts, workflows, security configuration, and integrations . The associate will collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, developers, QA, validation, infrastructure, integration, and support teams. The role includes Agile delivery, application support, defect resolution, testing, validation documentation, controlled deployment, and production monitoring. This role is not limited to supporting a single application or technology platform. The associate must demonstrate a strong learning mindset, adaptability, and the willingness to continuously develop new skills and capabilities. As business needs evolve, the individual will be expected to embrace cross-skilling opportunities, contribute across diverse technology domains, and support strategic initiatives while maintaining a high standard of quality, compliance, and delivery excellence. Roles and Responsibilities Maximo Configuration and Development Configure, develop, test, deploy, and maintain IBM Maximo solutions. Support key Maximo modules, including: Work Order Asset Location Purchasing Inventory-related processes, where applicable Maximo Integration Framework Configure applications using Application Designer . Perform object, attribute, domain, relationship, index, and other configurations using Database Configuration . Develop and maintain Automation Scripts using Python/Jython . Configure and support workflows, escalations, actions, conditional expressions, communication templates, cron tasks, and scheduled jobs. Configure security groups, application access, signature options, user permissions, and data restrictions. Evaluate business requirements and recommend solutions using standard Maximo configurations, automation scripts, integrations, or customizations. Follow coding, configuration, documentation, security, and technical-review standards. Create and maintain solution designs, configuration documents, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and support documentation. Integration Development and Support Configure, develop, test, and support integrations using Maximo Integration Framework (MIF) . Work with Object Structures, Enterprise Services, Publish Channels, External Systems, Endpoints, Integration Controls, APIs, and message queues. Support integrations between Maximo and SAP, middleware, data platforms, reporting tools, and other enterprise applications. Work with REST APIs, web services, JSON, XML, and file-based integrations. Perform data mapping, interface testing, message monitoring, error handling, reprocessing, and reconciliation. Investigate integration failures using application logs, integration logs, queue messages, and database queries. Coordinate with integration, database, infrastructure, security, and external application teams to resolve issues. Application Support and Operations Provide technical and functional support for Maximo and its integrations. Investigate incidents, service requests, application defects, data issues, and recurring production problems. Perform issue triage, impact assessment, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution. Monitor cron tasks, scheduled jobs, interfaces, integration queues, and application logs. Support critical incidents, problem-management activities, and production releases. Document troubleshooting steps, root causes, resolutions, known errors, and preventive actions. Create and maintain knowledge articles, operational procedures, and support runbooks. Participate in on-call or after-hours support when required. Agile Delivery and Release Management Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, reviews, and retrospectives. Work with product owners and stakeholders to understand requirements, priorities, dependencies, risks, and acceptance criteria. Convert business requirements into configuration, development, integration, testing, and validation tasks. Provide effort estimates and maintain accurate updates for user stories, defects, and technical activities. Support change control, release planning, deployment, production verification, and post-release monitoring. Prepare implementation plans, deployment steps, validation evidence, verification activities, and rollback procedures. Follow approved source-control, configuration-management, change-management, and deployment processes. Quality Assurance Participate in requirements review, risk assessment, test planning, test-case preparation, execution, and defect management. Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, negative, end-to-end, and User Acceptance Testing scenarios. Validate Maximo configurations, business rules, security access, automation scripts, workflows, integrations, and data-processing results. Prepare test data and maintain accurate, complete, and traceable test evidence. Track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or an equivalent tool. Retest defect fixes and perform regression testing to confirm application stability. Maintain traceability between requirements, designs, test cases, defects, and test evidence. Support validation documents such as requirements, specifications, risk assessments, traceability records, test scripts, and validation summaries. Ensure application changes are assessed, documented, tested, approved, and deployed in accordance with applicable GxP procedures. Follow data-integrity, audit-trail, security, access-control, and electronic-record requirements. Document and support the investigation of deviations, test failures, and unexpected results. Support periodic reviews, audits, compliance assessments, and regulatory inspections when required. Security and Quality Follow secure development and configuration practices, including authentication, authorization, input validation, access control, and secure integration. Apply least-privilege principles when configuring application security and data access. Protect credentials, API keys, certificates, secrets, and sensitive configuration information. Ensure all technical changes are reviewed, tested, documented, traceable, and approved before implementation. Support technical-risk remediation, security reviews, access reviews, and audit-log assessments. Report security, compliance, data-integrity, or control concerns through the appropriate process. Learning and Cross-Skilling Demonstrate flexibility to work across multiple technologies and application domains based on business priorities. Actively participate in cross-skilling opportunities beyond IBM Maximo. Develop knowledge and contribute, when required, in areas such as: SAP EAM or SAP Plant Maintenance Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI solutions Data Engineering and Data Analytics Reporting and Business Intelligence Automation and digital workflow solutions Cloud technologies Enterprise integrations and other strategic applications Learn new tools, technologies, and business processes and apply them to development, support, and transformation initiatives. Contribute to innovation, process automation, operational improvements, and AI-driven solutions. Basic Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field. 2 to 6 years of relevant experience in application configuration, development, integration, testing, or production support. Hands-on experience with IBM Maximo configuration, development, integration, or application support. Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery teams is preferred. Experience supporting GxP-regulated or validated applications is preferred. Required Skills Working knowledge of all Maximo modules. Hands-on experience with: Application Designer Database Configuration Automation Scripts using Python/Jython Domains and relationships Conditional expressions Workflows and escalations Cron tasks and scheduled jobs Security groups and data restrictions Experience with Maximo Integration Framework, including Object Structures, Enterprise Services, Publish Channels, External Systems, Endpoints, and Integration Controls. Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, JSON, XML, and file-based integrations. Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL for troubleshooting and data validation. Understanding of software testing, including functional, integration, regression, smoke, negative, end-to-end, and UAT. Experience creating test cases, executing tests, documenting results, and managing defects. Understanding of GxP validation, change control, risk assessment, requirements traceability, test evidence, and controlled deployment. Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery practices. Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Git, source control, peer reviews, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Strong learning agility and willingness to cross-skill into additional technologies. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with IBM Maximo Application Suite or Maximo Manage. Knowledge of Python beyond Maximo Automation Scripting. Advanced SQL and database troubleshooting experience. Knowledge of Java, JavaScript, REST APIs, XML, and JSON. Experience with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft. Experience integrating Maximo with SAP, ERP, data platforms, reporting tools, or third-party applications. Exposure to SAP EAM or SAP Plant Maintenance. Exposure to AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or intelligent automation. Exposure to Databricks, Azure Data Services, Snowflake, or similar data platforms. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, BIRT, or similar reporting tools. Knowledge of Postman or other API-testing tools. Understanding of manufacturing, maintenance, calibration, procurement, inventory, and asset-management processes. Relevant IBM Maximo, Agile, testing, cloud, data, AI, or validation certifications. Behavioral Competencies Demonstrates ownership and accountability for assigned responsibilities. Maintains attention to detail, particularly for GxP documentation and test evidence. Communicates technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborates effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Adapts to changing business priorities and technology requirements. Demonstrates curiosity, continuous learning, and a proactive cross-skilling mindset. Works across development, configuration, integration, testing, validation, and support activities. Manages multiple priorities effectively in an Agile environment. Commits to application quality, compliance, operational reliability, and continuous improvement. .

cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Software Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Software Engineer opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: AI Data Scientist, OTDS – Manager (Individual Contributor)
jobs.description: Career Category Information Systems Job Description ABOUT AMGEN Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today. ABOUT THE ROLE You will play a critical role in advancing Amgen’s Operations Transformation and Digital Strategy (OTDS) by guiding the design and delivery of next-generation AI solutions that modernize how data, knowledge, and content are created, connected, governed, and consumed across the enterprise, in collaboration with the Operations AI Transformation Team. This role focuses on scaling the application of Generative AI, agentic AI, integrated data, and semantic technologies across high-impact business domains. You will deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions in close collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology partners. You will be responsible for shaping strategy, driving execution, and ensuring the successful delivery of AI-enabled transformation initiatives, particularly within regulatory, operational, and data-centric use cases. This role combines strong technical depth with product thinking and the ability to influence at scale in a highly regulated environment. Role Description The AI Data Scientist Manager is responsible for designing, developing, and scaling AI-driven solutions that combine Generative AI, agentic AI, semantic data, and enterprise data platforms to create measurable business value. This role requires a balance of technical expertise and strategic thinking , with accountability for delivery. You will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions—from ideation and prototyping to production deployment, while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards for Responsible AI, compliance, and data governance. With a focus on pharmaceutical and operational data domains, this role involves guiding the development of intelligent systems that leverage knowledge graphs, interoperable data models, and modern AI technologies. You will work across structured and unstructured data ecosystems using platforms such as AWS, Databricks, OpenAI APIs, and AWS Bedrock to deliver scalable and compliant solutions. This role also serves as a thought leader within OTDS, helping to define best practices, influence AI strategy, and foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and transformation. Roles & Responsibilities Ensure successful delivery of AI initiatives aligned with OTDS transformation goals. Design and oversee development of AI solutions using Generative AI, large language models, and agentic AI patterns . Guide the development of intelligent systems that combine structured and unstructured data, semantic models, and knowledge graphs . Ensure successful transition of solutions from proof-of-concept to scalable, enterprise-ready AI products . Provide technical leadership in Python-based development, SQL-based data transformation, and AI system design . Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and engineering partners to define and deliver high-impact AI use cases. Drive adoption of FAIR data principles , data-centric design, and semantic interoperability across solutions. Oversee use of AWS services and cloud best practices , including AWS Bedrock , to ensure scalable and secure architecture. Guide development of AI-enabled applications leveraging OpenAI APIs and foundation model platforms . Ensure effective use of Databricks and enterprise data platforms for scalable AI development and deployment. Establish and enforce standards for Responsible AI, model governance, security, and compliance , including awareness of frameworks such as the EU AI Act . Act as a key liaison between OTDS leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities and drive transformation outcomes. Facilitate strategic discussions and working sessions to align on AI vision, roadmap, and value realization. Adopt and promote a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence . Stay current with advancements in AI, agentic architectures, and regulatory expectations, and guide the team in applying them effectively. Basic Qualifications and Experience Master’s OR Bachelor’s degree with 7 to 12 years of experience in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Information Science, or related field Functional Skills Must-Have Skills Deep expertise in Generative AI, large language models, and agentic AI applications . Proficiency in Python for AI solution development and scaling. Strong working knowledge of SQL for enterprise data integration and analysis. Experience with AWS cloud services and well-architected design principles , including AWS Bedrock . Experience with OpenAI APIs and enterprise AI solution development. Hands-on experience with Databricks or similar data and AI platforms. Strong understanding of enterprise data ecosystems and integrated data architectures . Experience with knowledge graph technologies (e.g., Stardog, GraphDB) and semantic data approaches. Strong understanding of FAIR data principles and their enterprise application. Ability to translate business strategy into scalable AI solutions and execution roadmaps. Strong understanding of Responsible AI principles , governance, and compliance requirements. Familiarity with AI regulatory considerations, including concepts aligned with the EU AI Act . Good-to-Have Skills Experience in pharmaceutical or life sciences environments , particularly in regulatory or operational domains. Familiarity with regulatory data, submission processes, and compliance frameworks . Knowledge of machine learning and deep learning techniques supporting GenAI use cases. Experience integrating data across clinical, manufacturing, quality, or regulatory systems . Familiarity with FHIR, IDMP , or similar healthcare data standards. Experience scaling AI solutions into enterprise products and platforms . Exposure to structured content management and AI-driven content automation. Soft Skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences. Strategic thinking with the ability to align AI initiatives to enterprise transformation goals. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in complex, regulated environments. Ability to manage ambiguity and drive clarity across multiple initiatives. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and build cross-functional alignment. Strong customer- and product-oriented mindset. Passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and transformation . High level of ownership and accountability for both team outcomes and business impact. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. jobs.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. In support of that mission, the ChatGPT Ads team is building advertising products that help businesses reach customers in useful, trusted, and responsible ways. The Ads Strategy, Planning, and Operations team is responsible for building the operating foundation for OpenAI’s advertising business: GTM systems, segmentation, coverage, planning, forecasting, business rhythms, sales programs, incentives, and scalable execution across advertisers, agencies, partners, resellers, and internal teams. This team sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Policy, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success. About the role We’re looking for a Reseller & Ecosystem Programs Lead to build the ChatGPT Ads reseller program from the ground up and design ecosystem programs that accelerate advertiser adoption, partner productivity, and revenue growth. This role will define how OpenAI works with resellers and ecosystem partners across the Ads business: who we partner with, what motions they own, how they are enabled, how performance is measured, and how incentives should work. The ideal candidate has built reseller, channel, partner, or ecosystem programs in digital advertising, media, adtech, marketplace, or platform businesses and knows how to balance growth, control, customer experience, and platform integrity. In this role, you’ll: - Design and build the ChatGPT Ads reseller program, including partner segmentation, eligibility criteria, commercial model, operating model, onboarding, governance, and performance management. - Define the role of resellers and ecosystem partners across customer acquisition, activation, spend growth, market expansion, support, and scaled coverage. - Develop partner coverage and engagement models across advertisers, agencies, resellers, outsourced sellers, and other ecosystem participants. - Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, Policy, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Ads Ops to launch reseller motions that are commercially effective and operationally sound. - Design ecosystem acceleration programs that drive advertiser adoption, partner-sourced growth, activation, retention, and incremental spend. - Build partner enablement, certification, launch readiness, and operating review mechanisms. - Develop reseller and partner incentive structures with clear eligibility, measurement, controls, ROI tracking, and guardrails. - Create program playbooks, partner scorecards, reporting cadences, escalation paths, and governance mechanisms. - Monitor program performance and recommend whether to scale, refine, or sunset specific reseller and ecosystem motions. - Ensure reseller and ecosystem programs reinforce user trust, platform integrity, financial discipline, and long-term advertiser value.
